description: DEMO portfolio (synthetic, shared, read-only). Read ONE dimension of the portfolio's allocation — where the money is, and how far that is from the user's saved targets — instead of the whole context. dimension: assetClass, sector, region, currency, cap, type, account (default assetClass; there is no separate broker dimension — an account label IS its broker). depth (1-30, default 10) keeps the largest segments and groups the rest into `other`; a segment already named 'Other' is the app's own fold of its smallest segments. withTargets (default true) adds targetPct and driftPct in percentage points wherever the user has saved a target, and raises a target nothing matched so a 0% holding against a target is never invisible; targets exist for assetClass and sector only. weightBasis says what weightPct is a percent OF: 'portfolio' for every breakdown dimension, and 'accounts' for dimension=account, where the weights are a percent of the accounts' combined value (totalValue) because an asset held in no account is outside that split. Every value is in the display currency. `pending` names holdings whose market data has not landed — they are in no segment, so the split is not final while it is there. Describes the portfolio; never investment advice.
name: allocation
